Subject: Post-call: sandbox access & short checklist — confirm timing

Hi Liam — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

What we agreed
- Redwood will provision a dedicated sandbox with a small sample pipeline (S3->transform->inference) for your data engineering team.
- SageBridge will grant a sandbox admin and provide a representative dataset (anonymized CSV, ~50k rows) for initial testing.
- We suggested a two-week smoke test window to validate latency and cost for your most common query patterns.

Immediate next actions (owner / ETA)
1) Redwood: create sandbox & invite users (Ben) — ETA Wed 4/7. (Attachment: MAP_SageBridge_v1.xlsx)
2) SageBridge: share dataset & assign sandbox admin (Liam) — ETA Fri 4/9
3) Joint: 30-min follow-up to walk through the demo and blocking items — propose Mon 4/12 or Tue 4/13 (Ben/Monica)

Resources attached: a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP_SageBridge_v1.xlsx) and an invite stub for the sandbox. Also saving a calendar link here: https://cal.com/redwood/onboarding-30

Please confirm timing: is a 2-week smoke window still realistic from your side, or has priority shifted? If procurement needs more lead time we can extend the trial window and book a dedicated onboarding engineer.

Thanks — I’ll queue the infra ticket as soon as you confirm the admin user.

Best,
Ben

Hi Liam — Marissa here. Thanks for the time on Monday — wanted to offer a couple of options to make the onboarding easier for your team: 

1) Complimentary 60-minute onboarding workshop (Redwood engineer + CS) to run through sandbox setup, dataset ingestion, and a mini-tuning checklist. Monica will lead the session content.
2) One-time $2,000 setup credit applied to the pilot account if you commit to starting the smoke test within 30 days.

If procurement is the blocker, we can also provide a concise procurement checklist that outlines the minimum items they need (data handling, IP notes, trial dates) — I’ll attach it if that helps.

Would either of the above help move this forward? If yes, please reply with: (a) your preferred workshop time (Mon/Tue afternoons next week) and (b) who the procurement contact is (name/email).

If your priorities shifted, also fine to let us know — we can park the sandbox and reopen the MAP when you're ready.

Best,
